better_answer_example: As a final year IT undergraduate with a strong passion for Mac development, I've been focusing on enhancing my skills in Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB. I'm excited to leverage my skills and experience to contribute to a Mac development role and continue to grow as a professional.
